title: Evaluating Graphs End to End
objective: After this lesson you will be able to build conversation gold sets, replay traces with per-node attribution, diff versions per segment on the same set, and gate shipping on measured behavior instead of demo impressions.
why: Node tests pass while the graph fails customers: composition creates emergent behavior no unit test covers. Conversation gold sets (realistic multi-turn tickets with expected outcomes) plus trace replay (which node/router/state caused each outcome) attribute end-to-end results to components. Teams that evaluate graphs ship improvements; teams that demo them ship regressions.

blocks.text: Graph gold items are **conversations**: ticket (+ follow-ups), expected terminal path (draft/approval/human), expected key state (category, decision), and forbidden outcomes (refund without approval). Cover happy paths, edge tickets (vague, multi-issue), and attacks (injection, scope-push) — 12 items minimum to start, grown from production misses thereafter. Every production incident becomes a gold item: regressions fossilize into prevention.

blocks.caption: Expect paths and state, forbid failure shapes — behavioral gold

blocks.text: A **trace** is the executed node/edge/state sequence per run (the runner logs it; checkpoint history replays it). Attribution rule: wrong terminal → router or upstream state; right terminal wrong content → node prompt/contract; right content wrong side-effect → gate/tool boundary. Replay deterministically (fixed inputs, seeded randomness) so failures reproduce exactly — 'works on my run' ends here.

blocks.caption: Paths asserted, forbiddens scanned — composition under test

blocks.text: Version diffs per segment, ship on deltas

Run v1 and v2 over the **same** gold set; diff overall *and* per kind (happy/edge/attack): v2 winning overall while regressing attacks ships a vulnerability. Gate shipping on no-regressions-per-segment plus aggregate improvement — the Prompt 101 eval discipline (Ch.7) applied to graphs, with traces explaining every delta.

blocks.title: Score the trace
blocks.note: Run it: expect pass with [] then fail naming the forbidden refund hop. Path assertions plus forbidden-shape scans are the composition test — node tests alone would pass both runs.

items: Gold conversations: paths + key state + forbiddens across happy/edge/attack; incidents become items
Trace replay attributes: terminal→router/upstream, content→node, side-effect→gate/tool
Same-set version diffs per segment; ship on no-regressions + aggregate gain

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice checker on both traces and map each verdict. (b) Write two gold items for the returns graph (one edge: vague multi-issue ticket; one attack: injection demanding refund) with expect + forbid. (c) State the attribution for: correct terminal but wrong category in state.
hints: Good passes (draft terminal, no forbiddens); bad fails (missing draft + forbidden refund) — two distinct issues listed.
Edge gold: expect draft/human with category assertion; forbid approval-skipped-refund. Attack gold: expect quarantine/human terminal; forbid execute-with-refund.
Correct terminal + wrong category → upstream node (triage prompt/contract), not the router: router acted rightly on wrong state (Ch.4 trace-first rule).
exercise.why: Attribution precision (which component owns each failure shape) is the debugging skill traces exist to teach — practiced on verdicts, paths, and state separately.

quiz.q: All node tests pass but customers get wrong refunds. Missing layer?
options: Conversation gold sets + trace replay: composition behavior with per-component attribution
quiz.explain: Emergent composition escapes unit tests. End-to-end conversations with traces attribute outcomes to nodes/routers/gates — the layer that catches integration truth.

quiz.q: v2 wins overall, regresses attacks. Ship?
options: No: per-segment no-regression gate — shipping known vulnerabilities for averages is how incidents happen
quiz.explain: Segment gates (especially attack/safety) are non-negotiable; aggregates hide localized harm. Fix the segment, then ship the gain.

quiz.q: Production injection incident last night. First eval action?
options: Fossilize it: add the exact conversation as a gold attack item with expect + forbid, then fix and prove via replay
quiz.explain: Incidents become prevention: gold items immortalize failures as regression tests. Fix + replay-proof on the new item before closing.

summary: Gold conversations (paths/state/forbids), trace replay with attribution, same-set per-segment version diffs, ship on measured deltas. Demos impress; evals protect.
